QUOTE: With a callback registered, every call not on the allow list still runs. The callback only gets notified.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a tool not on the allow list still runs when a callback is registered, and only headless engines deny. The deny list is checked separately at step 8. Together these describe an effective default-allow posture at the gate for tools on neither list, though only when a callback is set.
